lean.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {V : E → ℝ} {κ : ℝ≥0} (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (κ : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ ‖v‖^2)
    {eta c eps : ℝ} (heta : 0 < eta) (hec : eta ≤ c) (hc : c < 1) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (q : E → E) (N : E → ℕ)
    (hrun : ∀ y, run (gradient V) eta eps y
      (N y + 1) y = some (q y, N y + 1))
    (Y : α → E) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hmoment : Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient V (Y ω)‖^2) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (N (Y ω) : ℝ) + 1) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (N (Y ω) : ℝ) + 1 ∂μ) ≤
        (2 + (1 + Real.log ((1-c)⁻¹)) / (-Real.log c)) *
          (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖gradient V (Y ω)‖^2 ∂μ) / eps))
approved_definition_context: The finite interpreter run(g,eta,eps,y,fuel,x) returns none at zero fuel; at positive fuel it evaluates g(x), sets next=y-eta*g(x), and returns some(x,1) if ||next-x||<=(1-eta)*eps. Otherwise it recurses at next with one less fuel and adds one to a successful returned query count. All arithmetic is exact real arithmetic.

Integrable is Bochner integrability with respect to the specified measure. A probability measure has total mass one. gradient is the real inner-product gradient, and fderiv is the real Frechet derivative. N takes values in natural numbers; (N y : real)+1 counts all gradient tests including the final successful test.
